hypothesis: A learned complex multifrequency propagator is representationally viable because retaining at most the lowest 64 temporal rFFT bins of the true train-only P_bg complex fields, with a bounded spatial Fourier support, will yield aggregate relative L2 no greater than 0.05 on a disjoint project-train calibration panel.
expected_mechanism: Each complex Helmholtz field contains arbitrary multipath phase and amplitude at one frequency. Reconstructing all stored times by a fixed inverse rFFT therefore avoids the failed single-arrival ansatz while preserving causality and source band limitation.

single_conceptual_variable.name: propagation_representation
single_conceptual_variable.candidate: bank of learned complex frequency-domain propagation fields

primary_metric: aggregate relative L2 of the fit-frozen minimum-coefficient spectral truncation on disjoint project-train calibration records

acceptance.candidate_selection: minimum real coefficients among fit cells satisfying fit relative L2 <= 0.05 and nf <= 64

failure_signal: No fit candidate with nf <= 64 reaches 0.05, or the fit-frozen candidate exceeds 0.05 aggregate relative L2 on calibration.

data_access.oracle_truth_use: capacity diagnosis only on fit and calibration project-train labels

parent_checkpoint.reason: analytic representation-capacity diagnostic with no trainable parent

rollback: Preserve r47 and all prior checkpoints. If rejected, do not train the <=64-bin Helmholtz bank; inspect wider frequency support or a different learned causal basis using project-train evidence only.
